scope: Final B1 report, exported arithmetic/timing/resource metadata, postprocessing source and disclosed validation boundaries. Prior independent semantic judgments are reused without re-adjudication.
measurement_boundaries_confirmed: MT times cover the direct translation call including template/tokenization, prefill and decode; seed setup precedes timing and Chinese filtering follows it.
Queueing, TTFT, DOM, first correct Chinese and sentence-end realtime latency are not independently measured by these offline times.
Whole-run CPU/request amortizes loading and auxiliary work; Hy Hello warmup is loading overhead, not an extra quality sample. Main62-request phases are separate.
GPU activity and GPU shared-memory readings are whole-host values; idle subtraction does not establish model-exclusive VRAM.
RSS, footprint, MLX allocator accounting and GPU shared memory overlap on unified memory and are not added.
Separate ASR/MT peak values are not added or described as a measured full-chain peak; no formal R20percent result is claimed.
Prompt records are post-hoc reconstruction from frozen inputs/templates/tokenizers, not runtime capture or tokenization timing; Hy lacks runtime length comparison.
The report does not promote any candidate or claim production-default replacement, candidate1x/Chrome/long-run/holdout acceptance.

validation_limits.saved_integrity_validation: Inspected the recorded passing execution/integrity checks; this final pass did not independently rehash every raw model and event artifact.
validation_limits.test_results: Root-reported36 backend/P2 tests,2 focused boundary tests and43 document-package tests/checks were not rerun by this reviewer.
validation_limits.strict_sensitivity: Different rubric from the frozen20/18; no direct mixed-rubric comparison or threshold change.

conclusion: The final report consistently records completed offline B1 experiments with no qualifying candidate. No material numeric, unit, denominator, scope or unrun-work contradiction was found in the reviewed artifacts.
